The EVAP could possibly be causing the Fuel Trim Cylinder Balance to be out of wack. Your gas tank is a positive pressure vessel, of which needs to stay at ~7psi to ensure that the fuel pump works properly. Could very likely be a gas cap that needs to be replaced. This would likely be the cheapest fix of the 4.

I would straight up replace the engine oil pressure sensor. Buy AC-Delco brand, try to stay away from their

If the gas cap doesn't fix the Fuel Trim Cylinder Balance, Fill your tank with Chevron or Shell Premium fuel. Costs a lot, but it could just be that you have been running cheap gas through your system for awhile and the injector nozzles are slightly clogged. Tier 1 fuels today are really good. For the Accelerator pedal, Just replace the potentiometer, or the pedal assembly, depends how its sold. (Stick with AC-Delco for this!)
